description: Create a new thread without a starter message, or start a new post in a forum or media channel. Type 10 is an announcement thread (announcement channels only), 11 is a public thread visible to anyone who can view the parent channel, and 12 is a private thread visible only to invited members and moderators; type defaults to 12 when omitted. In forum or media channels pass message to create the first post. Returns the created thread. Bot permissions it may need: Create Public Threads, Create Private Threads, Send Messages, View Channel, Embed Links. Changes Discord data and is not idempotent; check the result before retrying.

applied_tags.description: IDs of up to 5 forum tags to apply when creating a post in a forum or media channel

items.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string

auto_archive_duration.description: Duration in minutes to automatically archive thread after inactivity: 60, 1440, 4320, or 10080

channel_id.description: ID of the parent channel (text, announcement, forum, or media)

invitable.description: Whether non-moderator members can invite others to the thread; only applicable to private threads (type 12)

message.description: Contents of the first post or message; required when creating a post in a forum or media channel

allowed_mentions.description: Controls which mentions in the first post send a ping

parse.description: Mention types Discord may parse from the text: roles, users or everyone

replied_user.description: Whether to mention the author of the replied-to message

roles.description: IDs of roles that may be mentioned (up to 100)

items.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string

users.description: IDs of users that may be mentioned (up to 100)

items.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string

components.description: Interactive message components such as buttons or select menus (up to 40)

content.description: Text of the first post. At least one of content, embeds, sticker_ids or components is required.

embeds.description: Up to 10 rich embed objects to include in the starter post

flags.description: Message flags integer bitfield, such as SUPPRESS_EMBEDS (4) or SUPPRESS_NOTIFICATIONS (4096)

sticker_ids.description: IDs of up to 3 stickers to attach to the starter post

items.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string

name.description: Title or name of the new thread (1-100 characters)

rate_limit_per_user.description: Slowmode delay per user in seconds (0-21600)

reason.description: Audit log reason for creating the thread

type.description: Thread type: 10 (announcement thread in announcement channel), 11 (public thread in text channel), or 12 (private thread in text channel; default in text channels)
